title: Antigravity accounts
subtitle: Choose the Google account each Antigravity agent runs on. Switching keeps the conversation.

overview.defaultHint: Used when the composer does not pick an account.
overview.defaultUnavailableBody: New agents use the system sign-in until it is.

noQuota: agy reported no quota for this account.

callout.signedOutBody: Sign in with the Google account this profile should use.
callout.systemSignedOutBody: Run agy in a terminal on this host to sign in the system account.
callout.unusableTitle: Turned off to protect the system sign-in

empty.title: Add another Google account
empty.body: Each added account keeps its own sign-in. Pick it in the composer for new agents, or move a running agent to it when quota runs low.

how.title: How it works
how.switchBody: All accounts share one conversation store. A switch reopens the agent's session on the other account and continues where it was.
how.modelsTitle: The model list comes from the system sign-in
how.modelsBody: If an added account's plan lacks a model, pick one it has.
how.safetyBody: Each added account keeps its sign-in in its own profile. The plugin checks where agy stored it and turns off any account whose sign-in landed elsewhere.

dialog.addBody: Give it a name you will recognize, such as Work or Personal. You sign in next.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.removeBody: The stored sign-in is deleted. Conversations stay. Agents on this account must be switched before they can run again.

signin.title: Sign in to “{{label}}”
signin.step1Body: Sign in with the Google account this profile should use.
signin.step2Body: After you sign in, Google shows a code. You can also paste the full address of that page.

only: This command works on Antigravity agents only.
noMatch: No account matches. Type /account to see the list.
ambiguous: Several accounts match. Use the number from /account.
unusable: That account cannot be used right now.
